ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: The Abyss
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
FORSAKENCRAGS_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 6 of the biome-mod-architecture split). A drowned-in-darkness, obsidian-black highland biome and its own worldgen placement, fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Ships the biome and its own placement worker (RM_BiomeWorker_Abyss), the donor-content roster (Alpha Biomes' terrain/weather, Alpha Animals' fauna, Alpha Biomes/Alpha Genetics flora) transplanted wholesale from the frozen campaign twin, and a Mod Settings screen with the standard worldgen-rarity master toggle (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine — defaults = shipped behavior, 0 = never generates). No mechanics kit exists for this biome yet (the Unveiling weather, darkbeast Dark-halo behaviour, gust-wind variability are all unbuilt and land here later, at any point, with no dependency direction).
⚠️ Unlike most RimMandrake biome mods, this one is NOT donor-free: its terrain and texture name Alpha Biomes defs with no guard, inherited unchanged from the frozen campaign twin, so Alpha Biomes is genuinely required for full function. The eight wildPlants entries are individually MayRequire'd on Alpha Biomes/Alpha Genetics and the fourteen wildAnimals entries on Alpha Animals, so those degrade gracefully. Those donor creatures carry this biome's own invented names (vrakk, ulkhorr, kessik...) through Patches/Abyss_Rename.xml.
Two invented predators, the cindermare (cold-drain grip) and the skarnix (flees firelight), hunt here as RM_Cindermare and RM_Skarnix. The six Forsaken vaults are campaign plot content and stay in Utinni entirely.
The Abyss has its own cryptid (ABYSS_FREE_CRYPTID_1): visitors who come for the Dark and are never seen, known only by signs anyone can explain away (extra rings and caches, things swapped on a ring of shards, a clear pocket over nothing, whispers and a dream). No pawn, faction or certain structure of theirs exists. One setting turns it all off.
